Can Pollution Markets Work in Developing Countries? Experimental Evidence From India
abstract: Market-based environmental regulations are seldom used in low-income countries, where pollution is highest but state capacity is often low. We collaborated with the Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB) to design and experimentally evaluate the world’s first particulate-matter emissions market, which covered industrial plants in a large Indian city. There are three main findings. First, the market functioned well. Treatment plants, randomly assigned to the emissions market, traded permits to become significant net sellers or buyers. After trading, treatment plants held enough permits to cover their emissions 99% of the time, compared with just 66% compliance with standards under the command-and-control status quo. Second, treatment plants reduced pollution emissions, relative to control plants, by 20%–30%. Third, the market reduced abatement costs by an estimated 11%, holding constant emissions. This cost-savings estimate is based on plant-specific marginal cost curves that we estimate from the universe of bids to buy and sell permits in the market. The combination of pollution reductions and low costs imply that the emissions market has mortality benefits that exceed its costs by at least 25 times.
abstract_zh: 基于市场的环境规制在低收入国家很少使用，而这些国家的污染往往最为严重，但国家能力通常较弱。我们与古吉拉特邦污染控制委员会（GPCB）合作，设计并通过实验评估了世界上首个颗粒物排放市场，该市场覆盖了印度一座大城市的工业企业。研究有三项主要发现。第一，该市场运行良好。被随机分配进入排放市场的处理组工厂进行了许可交易，并成为显著的净卖方或净买方。交易之后，处理组工厂持有的许可足以覆盖其99%时间内的排放，而在现行的命令—控制型规制下，合规率仅为66%。第二，相对于对照组工厂，处理组工厂的污染排放减少了20%–30%。第三，在保持排放不变的情况下，该市场估计降低了11%的减排成本。这一成本节约的估计，基于我们从市场中买卖许可的全部报价中估计出的工厂特定边际成本曲线。污染减少与低成本的结合意味着，该排放市场带来的死亡率收益至少是其成本的25倍。

title: Comprehensive Monitoring of Air Pollution Hotspots Using Sparse Sensor Networks
venue: ACM Journal of Computing and Sustainable Societies
abstract:
Urban air pollution hotspots pose significant health risks, yet their detection and analysis remain limited by the sparsity of public sensor networks. This article addresses this challenge by combining predictive modeling and mechanistic approaches to comprehensively monitor pollution hotspots. We enhanced New Delhi’s existing sensor network with 28 low-cost sensors, collecting PM
2
.5 data over 30 months from May 1, 2018, to Nov 1, 2020. Applying established definitions of hotspots to this data, we found the existence of an additional 189 hidden monthly hotspots in addition to confirming the 660 detected by the public network. Using predictive techniques like Space-Time Kriging, we identified monthly hotspots with 95% precision and 88% recall with 50% sensor failure rate, and with 98% precision and 95% recall with 50% missing sensors. The projections of our predictive model were further compiled into policy recommendations for public authorities. Additionally, we developed a Gaussian Plume Dispersion Model to understand the mechanistic underpinnings of hotspot formation, incorporating an emissions inventory derived from local sources. Our mechanistic model is able to explain 65% of observed transient hotspots. Our findings underscore the importance of integrating data-driven predictive models with physics-based mechanistic models for scalable and robust air pollution management in resource-constrained settings.
abstract_zh: 城市空气污染热点对健康构成重大风险，但由于公共传感器网络稀疏，对其进行探测和分析的能力仍然有限。本文通过结合预测建模与机理方法，对污染热点进行全面监测，以应对这一挑战。我们在新德里现有的传感器网络基础上增设了28个低成本传感器，于2018年5月1日至2020年11月1日的30个月内收集了PM2.5数据。运用既有的热点定义对这些数据进行分析，我们发现，除公共网络探测到的660个热点外，还存在另外189个隐藏的月度热点。利用时空克里金等预测技术，我们在传感器故障率为50%的情况下识别月度热点的精确率为95%、召回率为88%；在传感器缺失率为50%的情况下，精确率为98%、召回率为95%。我们预测模型的结果被进一步整理为面向公共部门的政策建议。此外，我们还开发了高斯烟羽扩散模型，以理解热点形成的机理基础，该模型纳入了基于当地来源构建的排放清单。我们的机理模型能够解释65%的观测到的瞬时热点。我们的研究结果强调，在资源有限的环境中，将数据驱动的预测模型与基于物理的机理模型相结合，对于可扩展且稳健的空气污染管理至关重要。

title: Money (Not) to Burn: Payments for Ecosystem Services to Reduce Crop Residue Burning
abstract: We test whether payments for ecosystem services (PES) can curb the highly polluting practice of crop residue burning in India. Standard PES contracts pay participants after verification that they met a proenvironment condition (clearing fields without burning). We randomize paying a portion of the money up front and unconditionally to address liquidity constraints and farmer distrust, which may undermine the standard contract’s effectiveness. Incorporating partial up-front payment into the contract increases compliance by 10 percentage points, which is corroborated by satellite-based burning measurements. The cost per life saved is $3,600–$5,400. The standard PES contract has no effect on burning. (JEL D86, O13, Q12, Q15, Q18, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 我们检验生态系统服务付费（PES）能否遏制印度高污染的秸秆焚烧行为。标准的生态系统服务付费合约，是在核实参与者满足了环保条件（即不焚烧即清理田地）之后才支付报酬。我们随机安排部分款项提前、无条件支付，以应对流动性约束和农户的不信任问题，因为这些问题可能会削弱标准合约的效果。将部分提前支付纳入合约，使合规率提高了10个百分点，卫星遥感测得的焚烧数据也证实了这一结果。每挽救一条生命的成本为3600至5400美元。标准的生态系统服务付费合约对焚烧行为没有任何影响。（JEL D86, O13, Q12, Q15, Q18, Q53, Q58）

Modeling Fine-Grained Spatio-Temporal Pollution Maps with Low-Cost Sensors
abstract: The use of air quality monitoring networks to inform urban policies is critical especially where urban populations are exposed to unprecedented levels of air pollution. High costs, however, limit city governments’ ability to deploy reference grade air quality monitors at scale; for instance, only 33 reference grade monitors are available for the entire territory of Delhi, India, spanning 1500 sq km with 15 million residents. In this paper, we describe a high-precision spatio-temporal prediction model that can be used to derive fine-grained pollution maps. We utilize two years of data from a low-cost monitoring network of 28 custom-designed low-cost portable air quality sensors covering a dense region of Delhi. The model uses a combination of message-passing recurrent neural networks combined with conventional spatio-temporal geostatistics models to achieve high predictive accuracy in the face of high data variability and intermittent data availability from low-cost sensors (due to sensor faults, network, and power issues). Using data from reference grade monitors for validation, our spatio-temporal pollution model can make predictions within 1-hour time-windows at 9.4, 10.5, and 9.6% Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) over our low-cost monitors, reference grade monitors, and the combined monitoring network respectively. These accurate fine-grained pollution sensing maps provide a way forward to build citizen-driven low-cost monitoring systems that detect hazardous urban air quality at fine-grained granularities.
abstract_zh: 在城市人口暴露于前所未有的空气污染水平的地区，利用空气质量监测网络为城市政策提供信息至关重要。然而，高昂的成本限制了市政府大规模部署参考级空气质量监测仪的能力；例如，印度德里全境面积达1500平方公里、居住人口1500万，而可用的参考级监测仪仅有33台。本文描述了一种高精度的时空预测模型，可用于绘制精细尺度的污染地图。我们利用了一个由28台定制设计的便携式低成本空气质量传感器组成的监测网络两年的数据，该网络覆盖德里一个人口密集的区域。该模型结合了消息传递循环神经网络与传统的时空地统计模型，从而在低成本传感器数据变异性大、数据间歇性可得（由于传感器故障、网络和电力问题）的情况下，仍能实现较高的预测精度。利用参考级监测仪数据进行验证，我们的时空污染模型能够以1小时为时间窗口进行预测，其平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）在低成本监测仪上为9.4%，在参考级监测仪上为10.5%，在合并监测网络上为9.6%。这些精确的精细尺度污染感知地图，为构建由公民驱动的低成本监测系统指明了方向，此类系统能够以精细的粒度探测城市中的危险空气质量。

The Value of Regulatory Discretion: Estimates from Environmental Inspections in India
abstract: In collaboration with a state environmental regulator in India, we conducted a field experiment to raise the frequency of environmental inspections to the prescribed minimum for a random set of industrial plants. The treatment was successful when judged by process measures, as treatment plants, relative to the control group, were more than twice as likely to be inspected and to be cited for violating pollution standards. Yet the treatment was weaker for more consequential outcomes: the regulator was no more likely to identify extreme polluters (i.e., plants with emissions five times the regulatory standard or more) or to impose costly penalties in the treatment group. In response to the added scrutiny, treatment plants only marginally increased compliance with standards and did not significantly reduce mean pollution emissions. To explain these results and recover the full costs of environmental regulation, we model the regulatory process as a dynamic discrete game where the regulator chooses whether to penalize and plants choose whether to abate to avoid future sanctions. We estimate this model using original data on 10,000 interactions between plants and the regulator. Our estimates imply that the costs of environmental regulation are largely reserved for extremely polluting plants. Applying the cost estimates to the experimental data, we find the average treatment inspection imposes about half the cost on plants that the average control inspection does, because the randomly assigned inspections in the treatment are less likely than normal discretionary inspections to target such extreme polluters.
abstract_zh: 我们与印度一个邦的环境监管机构合作开展了一项田野实验，针对随机选取的一组工业工厂，将环境检查的频率提高到规定的最低标准。若以过程指标衡量，该处理是成功的：相较于对照组，处理组的工厂被检查的可能性和因违反污染标准而被处罚的可能性都高出一倍以上。然而，该处理对更重要的结果影响较弱：监管机构并未更有可能识别出极端污染者（即排放量达到监管标准五倍或以上的工厂），也未更有可能在处理组中施加高昂的罚款。面对额外的监督，处理组工厂仅略微提高了达标率，且并未显著降低平均污染排放量。为解释这些结果并还原环境监管的全部成本，我们将监管过程建模为一个动态离散博弈：监管机构选择是否处罚，工厂则选择是否减排以避免未来的制裁。我们利用10,000次工厂与监管机构互动的原始数据对该模型进行了估计。估计结果表明，环境监管的成本主要由污染极其严重的工厂承担。将成本估计结果应用于实验数据后，我们发现，处理组的平均检查给工厂带来的成本约为对照组平均检查的一半，原因在于随机分配的处理组检查比正常的自主检查更不可能针对此类极端污染者。

abstract: Using the most comprehensive developing country dataset ever compiled on air and water pollution and environmental regulations, the paper assesses India’s environmental regulations with a difference-in-differences design. The air pollution regulations are associated with substantial improvements in air quality. The most successful air regulation resulted in a modest but statistically insignificant decline in infant mortality. In contrast, the water regulations had no measurable benefits. The available evidence leads us to cautiously conclude that higher demand for air quality prompted the effective enforcement of air pollution regulations, indicating that strong public support allows environmental regulations to succeed in weak institutional settings.
abstract_zh: 本文使用迄今为止为发展中国家编制的最全面的空气和水污染及环境法规数据集，以双重差分设计评估了印度的环境法规。空气污染法规与空气质量的显著改善相关。效果最好的空气法规使婴儿死亡率出现了温和但统计上不显著的下降。相比之下，水污染法规没有产生可测量的效益。现有证据使我们谨慎地得出结论：对空气质量更高的需求促使空气污染法规得到有效执行，这表明在制度薄弱的环境中，强有力的公众支持也能使环境法规取得成功。

Truth Telling by Third Party Auditors and the Response of Polluting Firms: Experimental Evidence from India
abstract: In many regulated markets, private, third-party auditors are chosen and paid by the firms that they audit, potentially creating a conflict of interest. This paper reports on a two-year field experiment in the Indian state of Gujarat that sought to curb such a conflict by altering the market structure for environmental audits of industrial plants to incentivize accurate reporting. There are three main results. First, the status quo system was largely corrupted, with auditors systematically reporting plant emissions just below the standard, although true emissions were typically higher. Second, the treatment caused auditors to report more truthfully and very significantly lowered the fraction of plants that were falsely reported as compliant with pollution standards. Third, treatment plants, in turn, reduced their pollution emissions. The results suggest reformed incentives for third-party auditors can improve their reporting and make regulation more effective.
abstract_zh: 在许多受监管的市场中，私营第三方审计机构由其所审计的企业选定并付费，这可能造成利益冲突。本文报告了在印度古吉拉特邦开展的一项为期两年的田野实验，该实验旨在通过改变工业工厂环境审计的市场结构、激励准确报告，从而遏制此类冲突。研究有三项主要结果。第一，原有体系在很大程度上已被腐化，审计人员系统性地将工厂排放报告为略低于标准的水平，而实际排放通常更高。第二，处理组使审计人员的报告更加真实，并显著降低了被错误报告为符合污染标准的工厂比例。第三，处理组工厂相应地减少了污染排放。结果表明，改革第三方审计人员的激励机制可以提高其报告质量，并使监管更为有效。
